registry_info.description: Primitive lights: polyhedra of coloured light on bent arms, for the walls and columns of the tower.

crystal_sconce.name: Crystal sconce
crystal_sconce.description: A primitive as a lamp: a faceted bipyramid of coloured light (hexagonal crystal, square diamond or long kite) on a curved arm from a wall plate, with a soft lamp of its own colour inside. The origin is the plate's centre on the wall; the light projects along +Z, so a placement's height is its mounting height. Config: #shape:crystal|diamond|kite #colour:white|yellow|blue|violet|green|pink
